commands.cmd: p=$(command -v serena) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && eco="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem" && UV_TOOL_DIR="$eco/python-tools" UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR="$eco/bin" timeout 15 uv tool list | grep -A3 "^serena-agent " && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c='serena';print('stack.json version',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'| landscape winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))"
